description: Ministry of Defence - The Navy Act (Chapter 358) Order Under Section 21
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (President Anura Kumara Dissanayake) AND detailed responsibilities/portfolios being assigned (maintaining maritime security operations, providing services to foreign security companies, storing/transporting firearms and equipment, operational/administrative/financial activities under Ministry of Defence supervision). The combination of a specific person with detailed operational responsibilities makes this a Hybrid Gazette according to the classification rules.
